ManufacturersModelName: Brain Products actiCHamp Plus (actiCAP snap, gel-based active electrodes)
TaskDescription: [motor execution] Self-paced freewill reach-and-grasp: the subject freely chooses one of four cups and the timing of movement. Four cups (two water-filled, two empty) define the four classes. Trial duration: 12.0s.
InstitutionalDepartmentName: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
Description: A large EEG database of freewill reaching and grasping tasks for brain-machine interfaces: 23 subjects, 49 sessions, 6808 self-paced reach-and-grasp trials toward one of four cups.
